description:
This file defines an abstract class 'LeaveAllocate' within the 'OrangeHRM\[Leave	exttt{]}
' namespace, representing an event related to leave allocation in the HRM system.
It includes properties for leave request information, workflow state, and performer details, along with methods for accessing these properties.
The class serves as a base class for specific leave allocation events and integrates with the OrangeHRM event system.

classes.name: LeaveAllocate
classes.description: An abstract class representing a leave allocation event in the HRM system. It encapsulates information about the leave request, the workflow state, and the user performing the action.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LeaveAllocate event with the given leave request, workflow, and performer.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns a DetailedLeaveRequest object. Converts and fetches leave details if the leave request is originally of type LeaveRequest.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the leave event.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave allocation event.
